texts.title_text: High-speed train collision in Toledo, Spain, kills at least 68 people
texts.slide_1_text: Marking Spain's second major rail disaster this year, the crash involved two trains on the Madrid-Seville line.
texts.slide_2_text: One train struck a stopped service at high speed, derailing two carriages and causing structural damage.
texts.slide_3_text: Transport Minister Óscar Puente stated the control system in Urda failed, halting trains before the collision.
texts.slide_4_text: Regional leader Emiliano García-Page reported 24 fatalities on a Renfe train and the rest on an Iryo service.
